{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_float'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_float'].sum()

# Print the result
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}')

# Check average revenue
avg_revenue = df_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'Average revenue per completed order: {avg_revenue}')

# Check for any suspiciously high values
high_revenue = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_float'] > 10000]
print(f'Number of orders with revenue > $10,000: {len(high_revenue)}')"}
